2027-08-24 | Care coordinator: The patient said they did not know which site to go to.
2027-08-25 | Nurse: Staff sent a message with the visit location.
2027-08-26 | Family contact: There is no record that the location message was acknowledged.

Documented observations
- The patient stated they were unsure which location to attend.
- A location confirmation message was sent.

Care or access items
- Attendance access may remain unclear because receipt of the location message was not documented.

Information to confirm
- Confirm that the patient received and understood the location information.

Human-review note
- Please follow up on location confirmation before the scheduled visit.
